 Follow live: A semifinal Saturday you won’t want to miss at the FAGE WTA Finals
 Match Reaction 
 1m read
 14 Nov 2026
 1h ago
 WTA
 INDIAN WELLS, Calif. -- Welcome back to Indian Wells, where we’ve finally put the group standings away. After a week of keeping track of sets won and who needed whom to win, the FAGE WTA Finals are down to four singles players. Win today and you’re playing for the title on Sunday.
 Jessica Pegula and Mirra Andreeva get us started at noon PST, and if you’re wondering how their games match up, so are they. This will be their first meeting. Andreeva made it through three group matches without dropping a set, while Pegula had to save a match point against Linda Noskova on Thursday just to get here.
 FAGE WTA Finals championship matches will simulcast for free on Tennis Channel 2 
 Noskova still won her group, and she’ll play Elina Svitolina in the second semifinal. Svitolina is the only former champion left, and there was a point on Wednesday when it looked like she might be out before the weekend. Instead, she came back against Karolina Muchova and then took the third set 6-1 against Aryna Sabalenka to grab the last spot.
 Semifinals day is here 🤩 Who will make it to tomorrow's finals? Both FAGE WTA Finals championship matches will simulcast for free on @TennisChannel 2 on Nov. 15! #FAGEWTAFinals | #TheUltimateStage https://t.co/4mSFJ766TL
— wta (@WTA) November 14, 2026 
 We’ll be here for both matches, with updates, highlights and a few polls along the way.
